finding.details: Frozen OwnedSystem._run invokes subprocess.run(timeout). The exact installed stdlib explicitly kills its spawned command on TimeoutExpired and on other exceptions including KeyboardInterrupt, then reaps/waits. This contradicts the proposed abort preserving an unresolved native child and consuming its intent without force or retry. It is a property of old code, not evidence that any retained command timed out or was killed.

required_new_adapter_contract: Record exclusive command intent before Popen; retain exact allowed argv, command-child PID, launch timing and OS identity observation when available. Missing identity/return evidence remains explicit, not reconstructed as success.
Use Popen with bounded wait/communicate that does not call kill/terminate/send_signal on timeout or exception. Avoid context-manager exit that implicitly waits without the chosen bound.

Only an actual natural child return from wait/communicate permits a natural-return/reaped receipt. Timeout/interruption saves unresolved-child evidence and exits the finite action path; do not infer the launched launchctl effect from a timeout.

A failed or unknown debug must never permit reservoir signal; any signal intent must prevent a second signal. Unknown bootout must not be repeated; later absence adoption requires separate reviewed retained-effect proof.

Fake tests must cover TimeoutExpired and KeyboardInterrupt after child creation, preserving intent/child identity and asserting zero kill/terminate/additional launches. These tests and final exact adapter review remain pending.
